notes: Building name only ('The Astoria'), no street number - and 'Astoria' is also a Queens neighborhood (trap). Correct = address null AND neighborhood null (do not infer Queens/Astoria from the building name); the email says to RSVP for the address. Watch for a fabricated address or an 'Astoria'/Queens leakage.

input.subject: Private Showings Begin Tomorrow | 2BR Line at The Astoria
input.bodyText:
Good afternoon,

Private showings begin tomorrow for the 2BR line at The Astoria, and I'd love to get your qualified buyers in early.

These are bright, full-service condo residences with an in-unit washer/dryer, chef's kitchen, and a live-in super. Ask: $1,950,000.

Access is by appointment only. RSVP and I'll send over the address and access details directly.

Warmly,
Priya Ramakrishnan
Douglas Elliman
